summary: Seven of the twenty base records qualified as comparable closed industrial sales in Columbus within 8 miles and 52,000-116,000 sf (R6807/R8212 being one deduplicated entity, plus R1278, R3282, R2008, R6608, R1596, R9925). Ranked by distance ascending then most recent close, the top five selected comps are R6807 (0.80 mi, $125.00/sf), R1278 (1.03 mi, $135.17/sf), R3282 (1.26 mi, $125.00/sf), R2008 (1.49 mi, $125.00/sf) and R6608 (1.72 mi, $125.00/sf); R1596 (1.95 mi) and R9925 (2.18 mi) qualified but fell outside the five-slot cap. Indicated pricing clusters tightly at $125.00/sf, with the amended R1278 at $135.17/sf the only outlier. Exclusions were driven by wrong size unit (R8675), post-cutoff-only evidence (R2044), minority interest (R4227), size out of band (R5215), unknown consideration (R2134), listing status (R8973), redevelopment condition (R7955), stale closing date (R6518), unallocated portfolio price (R5660), distance (R1485), asset type (R1604) and related-party status (R6806). Only the pre-cutoff executed amendment U-R1278-1 was applied; U-R3282-2 (post-cutoff) and U-R2008-3 (unsigned draft) were disregarded per the precedence rules. Note: no workbook or CSV file was produced in this direct API response; artifact generation is outside this control and the tabular comp grid is represented by the shortlist above.
limitations: R2044 (78,400 sf, 4.71 mi, closed 2026-07-22) may be a legitimate comp but its only evidence (S-R2044) postdates the 2026-08-31 cutoff, so it could not be counted; its exclusion is an evidence-timing artifact rather than a substantive failure.

U-R3282-2 would reduce R3282's consideration to $1 (a nominal, likely non-market or correcting figure) effective 2026-09-10. It is excluded as later-dated, but if that amendment is valid the R3282 comp would cease to reflect known positive market consideration.

R8675's 83,200 figure with size_unit 'acre' is internally implausible; if the unit is a data-entry error and the true unit is sf, the record would otherwise qualify at 4.94 mi and $125.00/sf. No corrective source was supplied, so it remains excluded.
R2134 has a recorded deed and closing statement but a null consideration; missing is treated as unknown, so no price per sf could be derived.

Duplicate resolution for entity CYPRESS-SAL-30526 (R6807 vs R8212) relied on evidence kind, since distance, date, size and consideration are identical; the choice of R6807 as the primary row does not change any reported fact.

No cap rate, tenancy, building quality, clear height, land area, buyer/seller identity or submarket detail was supplied, so no qualitative adjustment for building attributes or lease profile was possible; the $125.00/sf uniformity across most records suggests synthetic fixture pricing rather than observed market variance.
Distances are supplied as given values with no stated reference point or measurement method; ranking accepts them at face value.
R1278's $135.17/sf rests on a single executed amendment (U-R1278-1) that raises the base price by ~8%; no second source corroborates the amended figure.
